"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Jovan speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Nora.
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Fatima.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the north called The Red Table II. The region is bigger than your fire.
🧳 Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table II has bound itself to Emberhold. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
